body.statement: On the affine high-hazard subfamily, \(\sup_{r\in\mathcal R}\operatorname{Var}(Z_{r,\bar q_H})\le M^2[100-(1/2)\log(201)]/10000<0.009735M^2\), so \(b_{0.05}(\bar q_H)\le0.442M\). Consequently the certified interval has radius at most \(0.442M+s+5\cdot2^{-n}\) on \(G_n\) for all sufficiently large \(n\), for every \(s>0\).
body.justification: The strict numerical upper bound shows that profile adaptation delivers a nonvacuous width gain on a legal subclass without assuming observed rare marks reveal all counterfactual residuals.
body.gap: CookMishlerRamdas2024 studies truncation empirically and asymptotically, but does not certify a robust atomic radius over unknown signed residual profiles.
body.consumer: An adaptive trial with a prespecified affine exploration floor receives an explicit conservative radius benchmark.
